text: can you make some logos for my cycling club
withheld: The club name is Moss & Mile.
Every option must say Moss & Mile, including the ampersand, with no extra text.
There should be three logo options.
Each logo should be a separate square image, not a collage or contact sheet.
Use green and black on white.
Each logo should include the name and a small symbol.
The symbols and fonts are your choice.
The options should have genuinely different symbol or layout ideas, not just different colors of one design.
Each image should be 640 by 640 pixels.
